title: Spark: Driver, Executors, Jobs, Stages, Tasks

scenes.line1: Who runs your code in Spark?
scenes.say: Ever wonder who actually runs your code in Apache Spark? Is it the driver, or the executors?

scenes.label: Driver
scenes.sub: Coordinates jobs, plans, and schedules tasks.
scenes.say: The driver is Spark's boss. It plans your job and tells everyone what to do.

scenes.label: Executor
scenes.sub: Runs tasks and processes data on workers.
scenes.say: Executors are the workers. They actually run the tasks and process your data.

rows.b: Created by an action, like count()
Split by shuffles in your job

scenes.say: When you run an action like count, the driver creates a job, splits it into stages wherever data shuffles, and then breaks those stages into tasks—one per partition.

scenes.question: Who runs the tasks in Spark?
scenes.right: Executors run tasks. The driver only coordinates.
scenes.say: Don't get tripped up: the driver coordinates, but executors actually run the tasks.
